notes: Structure as living-room.json. placement uses the product-card enum. z = layer order bottom to top; shadow at z-1 unless has_shadow_layer is false. plan_m in house coordinates, Z from the floor. envelope_cm = max envelope per variant; 3 variants within +-15%. frames = master frames where the product is visible by design. The hall and living products seen at the end of the enfilade are neighbouring-room products (rendered with their defaults, U9), not counted here. hotspot and zoom_frame after the shell render.
